description: World trade by product (HS 2022): 96 product groups (HS chapters) and every HS 4-digit heading with world exports of US$5bn or more. For a product: world exports (US$ bn, latest BACI year, annual change), largest exporters and importers (share, tonnes, US$ per tonne for goods priced by weight), who sells to whom, the HS 6-digit lines inside, an IMF commodity price where one maps, and live monthly signals (main exporters' monthly exports y/y from UN Comtrade; weekly ship tonnage for chapters). Omit product for the largest groups; give an HS code ('27', '2709') or a name fragment ('crude', 'chips', 'soybeans').

product.description: HS chapter (2 digits), HS heading (4 digits) or name fragment; omit for the product-group list
